## Load libraries

```{r}
#| message: false
library("tidyverse")
library("msigdbr")
```

## Load data

The analysis is done on the results of the differential expression analysis

```{r}
#lm_results <- read_tsv("../data/05_dat_lm_results.tsv.gz")

lm_results |> 
  count(is_significant, sex_chrom)
```

```{r}
bp_df <- msigdbr(species = "human", #selects gene sets for human genes.
                 category = "C5", #selects the Gene Ontology collection.
                 subcategory = "GO:BP") #biological processes

head(bp_df)
```

The `msigdbr` package was used to retrieve gene sets from C5 which contains gene sets from the Gene Ontology. In particular I selected the biological process subcollection, so the dataset `GO_df` contains information about the biological processes associated with each gene.

```{r}
bp_df |>
  summarise(
    n_gene_sets = length(unique(gs_name)),
    n_genes = length(unique(ensembl_gene))
  )

go_sets |>
  count(gs_name, gs_description) |>
  arrange(desc(n))
```

The dataset contains 7658 gene sets (biological processes) and 20541 genes.
